description: List your workspace's usage signals, newest first, with counts for the same window: the total, a count per event type and the five customers with the most signals. Filter by time, agent_id, customer_id and event_type; every filter narrows the rows and the counts alike. list_usage_signal_filters names the customers and event types your signals use. Needs a Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

end_date.description: Only signals up to this time, ISO 8601.

event_type.description: Only these event types (at most 50; a type containing a comma cannot be named).

limit.description: Most signal rows to return. Defaults to 100.

start_date.description: Only signals from this time on, ISO 8601.

name: list_usage_signals
